about_the_game:
Forbidden Island is a choice-driven visual novel game.

David has been working as a ship mechanic since the age of 18. While the White Queen passenger ship is sailing across the Pacific Ocean toward America, a sudden storm strikes during the night, causing the ship to sink. Very few people survive.

David wakes up on a deserted island, where he meets Georgia and John, who have also washed ashore. From that moment on, their only goal is to survive and find a way to escape the island.

As the player, you will decide David’s path.

Will he focus solely on surviving and escaping the island, or will he try to survive while also following his passions and emotions? The choice is yours.

Forbidden Island features two different endings, both determined by your decisions. Witness the struggle for survival of David and the others, guide his actions, and share in their moments of hope, fear, joy, and despair as you decide how their story will end.

Adult Content Notice:
Some adult content appears only through player choices. If no choices are made, there are no sexual acts or adult scenes; some scenes may depict nudity. All adult content is optional and choice-driven within the narrative.

AI Usage Notice:
The first 12 visuals shown at the start of the game are generated by Google Gemini AI to support the prologue and story introduction. These AI-generated visuals only appear at the beginning of the game and are replaced by in-game visuals as the game progresses. No AI is used for the store page, marketing materials, community assets, or gameplay mechanics.

The game is a single version with no additional packages or DLC.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains adult themes.
The story includes romantic and emotional interactions, and some adult content appears only through player choices. If no choices are made, there are no sexual acts or adult scenes; some scenes only depict nudity.
The game does not contain violence, sexual assault, non-consensual acts, drug use, or self-harm.
At the beginning of the game, before the main story starts, a short prologue shows how the characters ended up on the island, the shipwreck, and who the characters are. This prologue uses 12 images generated with Google Gemini AI; these images do not appear anywhere else in the game.
